title: Microsoft 365 admin center: rules that automate agent lifecycle management
summary: Hold: the description of registry risk signals omits Microsoft's requirement for an E7 or A365 licence, which matters for tenants using the included lifecycle rules. The roadmap facts and the listed paths and block endpoint are supported; the included-licensing statement needs its supporting service-description citation.
